capability: Share a counter between scoped threads with an atomic instead of &mut.
observed_failure:
error[E0499]: cannot borrow `*counter` as mutable more than once at a time
 --> src/lib.rs:4:21
  |
3 |     std::thread::scope(|scope| {
  |                        ------- first mutable borrow occurs here
4 |         scope.spawn(|| { *counter += 1; });

prompt_intro: This crate does not compile. Both scoped closures try to hold the same mutable reference to the counter, which Rust forbids. Take an `AtomicU32` instead, add one per closure, and return the final value.
